_comment: The agent registry. Each entry is one AG-UI endpoint OpenBot can register,
and one name a case file can be addressed to with `assignee:`.
command   : the program that runs the agent. It reads the prompt on stdin
(prompt_mode: stdin), as one argument (prompt_mode: arg), or
with {prompt} substituted into an argument (prompt_mode: argv).
cwd       : where it runs. Point this at the agent-library checkout.
timeout   : seconds before the run is abandoned.
An entry with an empty command is listed but not runnable — it is a
placeholder. Fill the command in and restart the bridge.

agents.name: echo
agents.description: Built-in example. Echoes the prompt back, so the bridge can be proved working before a real agent is wired up.

agents.name: glm
agents.description: Z.ai GLM — second opinion, long-context review.
